description: This file defines data classes and a base grain class used for testing log consistency providers in an Orleans-based project. It includes serializable state classes with update methods and an abstract grain class implementing various state mutation and query methods.

classes.name: MyGrainState
classes.description: Serializable class representing the state of a grain, including fields A, B, and Reservations, with methods to apply updates.

classes.name: UpdateA
classes.description: Serializable class representing an update operation for field A.

classes.name: UpdateB
classes.description: Serializable class representing an update operation for field B.

classes.name: IncrementA
classes.description: Serializable class representing an increment operation for field A.

classes.name: AddReservation
classes.description: Serializable class representing an add reservation operation.

classes.name: RemoveReservation
classes.description: Serializable class representing a remove reservation operation.

classes.name: LogTestGrain
classes.description: Abstract class for a grain used in testing log consistency, providing methods to manipulate and retrieve state, including event raising, conditional updates, and state synchronization.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Override to perform actions upon grain activation.

methods.name: SetAGlobal
methods.description: Sets field A globally and confirms events.

methods.name: SetAConditional
methods.description: Attempts to set field A conditionally based on version.

methods.name: SetALocal
methods.description: Sets field A locally without synchronization.

methods.name: SetBGlobal
methods.description: Sets field B globally and confirms events.

methods.name: SetBLocal
methods.description: Sets field B locally.

methods.name: IncrementAGlobal
methods.description: Increments field A globally.

methods.name: IncrementALocal
methods.description: Increments field A locally.

methods.name: GetAGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves the global value of A after refresh.

methods.name: GetALocal
methods.description: Retrieves the tentative local value of A.

methods.name: GetBothGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves both A and B from the global state.

methods.name: GetBothLocal
methods.description: Retrieves both A and B from the tentative local state.

methods.name: AddReservationLocal
methods.description: Adds a reservation in the local state.

methods.name: RemoveReservationLocal
methods.description: Removes a reservation in the local state.

methods.name: GetReservationsGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves reservations after refresh.

methods.name: SynchronizeGlobalState
methods.description: Synchronizes the global state with the persisted state.

methods.name: GetConfirmedVersion
methods.description: Returns the current confirmed version.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads the current version and state.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Performs a conditional update on the state over a list of updates.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the grain.

methods.name: GetEventLog
methods.description: Retrieves the list of confirmed events.
